p0: The land is fully developed and serviced. Power feasibility is approved.
p1: Current power feasibility is 6,000 kVA for the park, with 800 kVA available for immediate contracting. Guaranteed water supply with storage cisterns, and a storm drainage system designed with channels and crossings that protect your operation in any season. Natural gas and internet round out the utilities.
p2: Access points, truck courts and internal roads were laid out for heavy traffic and smooth tractor-trailer circulation, with a control booth at each site, CCTV, perimeter wall, security gatehouse and a Business Center at the main entrance.
p3: Behind it all, professional park management that maintains, monitors and responds —because a park isn't delivered once: it's operated every day.

flex.title: Sixteen ways to enter the park.
flex.p1: Rarely can a single park accommodate both a company that needs 18,000 m2 (200,000 ft2) for lease and another that wants to buy 15 hectares to build its campus. True Ciénega can.
flex.p2:
That flexibility is no accident: it's how we designed the park to support companies at different stages of their growth. You start by leasing, then you buy.
 You buy three hectares, then you expand.
flex.p3: The final configuration is defined with you before closing.

quality.title:
Built to last,
 designed to perform.
quality.lead: Class A specifications in every building:
quality.item2: High load-capacity 15 cm concrete floors, MR40
quality.item3: Tilt-up or precast concrete walls, steel structure with trusses and KR-18 roof deck.
quality.item4: Sufficient loading docks and ramps per building, based on area
quality.item5: Efficient lighting and layout defined by operational flow
quality.p: Quality doesn't show in the renderings; it shows ten years later, when the building still performs like it did on day one. That's the standard we build to.
